blockers.clause: 3(e): share, publish, distribute, or lease the software ... or transfer the software or this agreement to any third party.
blockers.finding: Exact package embeds proprietary Microsoft terms restricting redistribution. Retained issue/comments contain no additional grant. Do not substitute the parent MSAL MIT license.
blockers.resolution: Obtain applicable official redistribution permission for these exact two DLLs, or separately authorize a runtime replacement/removal and re-audit every changed file. No runtime changes made.

scope_notes: Only 50 shipped executable files, plus existing GCM config/notices; 44 map to exact NuGet packages, six to GCM itself.
Whole files differ from NuGet due to Authenticode re-signing; ALL other bytes match. This is not signature verification.
Official complete same-release notice files retained verbatim and deduplicated by SHA-256, including sections for other platforms; retention does not assert those components ship.
NuGet lower-bound dependencies are discovery hints, not exact resolved versions. DiagnosticSource 6.0.1, not 6.0.2; System.Text.Json package 8.0.5 contains ProductVersion 8.0.10.
No deps.json in net472 payload. Evidence uses exact package members, complete PE non-signing bytes, NuGet nuspec revisions, and recorded PE ProductVersion.
NuGet package signatures and executable Authenticode signatures not verified. Official HTTPS + local SHA is not independent publisher authentication.
